scientific_integrity: Complete all-rank proof and reproducibility code are included; no independent proof audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Literal finite Zimin words with increasing ordered alphabet only.
Sentinel-free cyclic Burrows–Wheeler transform; results need not hold after appending a terminator.
The rank-two run count is two, not the general rank-at-least-three value; all formulas retain this boundary.
Low-rank instances, including the rank-three 'abacaba' example, are already present in prior descriptions.
Independent mathematical review and exhaustive historical priority are not established.
title: Exact suffix arrays and cyclic Burrows–Wheeler runs of finite Zimin words
